改善点: I often say "You can shear the sheep over & over again but you can only cut it's throat once." That said, it's clear to me now that Aircall is in the throat-cutting business. I signed up for an outbound campaign service and agreed to pay $300 for 3 months. What they never disclosed and I never agreed to was added billing charges for outbound calls. タイトル: Exceptional CRM Integration Hindered by High Costs and Seat Minimums
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー エグゼクティブ・オフィス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Exceptional CRM Integration Hindered by High Costs and Seat Minimums"
良い点: What makes Aircall exceptional is its best-in-class, frictionless CRM integration ecosystem. The app embeds seamlessly into platforms like Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, and Pipedrive. When a call comes in, the automatic contact pop-up instantly displays the caller’s past history, while call recordings, disposition tags, and AI summaries are logged automatically without leaving the CRM window. This eliminates manual data entry and dramatically increases rep productivity.
改善点: aggressive pricing model, strict seat minimums, and heavy feature gating. Enforcing a mandatory 3-license minimum makes it unnecessarily expensive for small teams, while essential tools like Salesforce integrations, live call monitoring, power dialers, and AI summaries are locked behind higher tiers or paid add-ons.

改善点: I felt that Aircall's capabilities were limited compared to other outbound calling services I have used before. Sequencing was limited and the ability to run several calls simultaneously is necessary for high volume outreach.

タイトル: Reliable calling, but rigid contracts and hidden costs at renewal
投稿者: Peter ドイツのCEO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 研究, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Reliable calling, but rigid contracts and hidden costs at renewal"
良い点: Call quality and day-to-day functionality were reliable, and outbound calling through the platform helped us close real business — we can trace concrete deals directly to outreach done via Aircall.
改善点: Contract and billing flexibility is poor. We ended up paying for unused plan capacity (5 users, international calling bundle) for roughly a year without any proactive check-in from Aircall to flag the mismatch. We were also forced into two separate unwanted full-price contract extensions: once from a missed cancellation deadline with zero flexibility offered, and again when porting our number out to a new provider required a full extra month at full price, with no reduced or number-only option available.

改善点: We experienced a lot of connectivity issues, and sometimes calls wouldn't come through at all. The call log in the work space area still l listed those missed calls.

タイトル: Helpful for Privacy, but Reliability Needs Improvement

良い点: What I liked most about Aircall is that it allows me to make and receive work-related calls without using my personal phone number. That added layer of privacy is a big benefit and makes it much easier to keep work communication separate from my personal life. It has been especially useful for maintaining that boundary while still staying accessible.
改善点: What I liked least about Aircall is the inconsistency. Calls can drop, notifications are sometimes missed, and that makes it harder to rely on when communication needs to be seamless. It also has not been the easiest app to navigate, so the overall experience can feel more frustrating than it should.

The integration with Salesforce is seamless and powerful: calls are automatically logged in the corresponding contact or lead records, call recordings and notes are directly attached to Salesforce activities, and our sales team can initiate calls directly from Salesforce with a single click (Click-to-Dial). This has drastically reduced manual data entry and improved CRM data accuracy. Getting started was incredibly fast — numbers can be provisioned in just a few clicks, and onboarding new team members takes minutes, not days. VR, call routing, business hours, shared inboxes, call tagging, and analytics provide everything a growing team needs to manage calls professionally.
改善点: The analytics are good, but more advanced and customizable reports would be a welcome addition Occasionally, we've experienced minor call quality issues (echo, latency, or dropped calls), especially on weaker internet connections.

タイトル: I had a poor experience with Aircall
投稿者: Andrew アメリカのManager 小売, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "I had a poor experience with Aircall"
良い点: Overall I did not like my experience with aircall and felt it was very poor.
改善点: Overall my experience with Aircall has been very negative. Initially I was switching over from RingCentral simply for the feature that allows me to have a chrome-extension in order to easily call/text customers via our shopify dashboard. In the process I had a hard time porting over the phone numbers. It was usually very difficult to get basic tasks like the phone number to work, and reaching customer service help was tough. Not to mention the steep price tag. I also managed to pay for "AI convo summaries" which I never was able to work with. I then realized that ring central offers exactly what I was hoping for all along and quickly switched back. Now I'm having an incredibly hard time cancelling. When I was signing up, the sales rep promised that I can cancel anytime and when I asked for that in writing he declined but said he would be able to cancel on my behalf if ever needed. I was directly lied to and manipulated when signing up, that should have been a warning to begin with. Avoid this company at all costs as there are much better options out there for much cheaper (Ring Central). I am writing this review because it is likely the ony way management will even look into my case and give me some sort of reply.

It is really helpful with Sales, Retention, and Account Management. Helps me to hear exactly what's happening on the call, so that I can train my team members, and help them hone specific pitches.
改善点: I have no complaints, it's the best VOIP service I've used.

改善点: The reporting is not deep unless you pay higher membership. Depending on the company's need it is not that overpriced. There is no way to have your SMS saved if someone calls you in the middle of your typing and you receive notification for every single sms coming in even though you did not send the sms without the possibility to assign it... Lots of improvement could be done there in my opinion (tags, search for users...)

When this happens, you have to log all the way out and then log back in. One last thing I would change, is when a customer calls in, after the phone rings several seconds, it says NO ONE WAS AVAILABLE TO ANSWER that call. But that wouldn't be the case.
